skipped.reason: Handwritten official NCAA box score scan dated Nov 25, 1977 at St. John Arena, Columbus, Ohio (Ohio State vs. an opponent whose name is illegible in cursive). Team point totals (TP column) sum to plausible team scores (opponent 82, Ohio State 99) matching printed TOTALS rows and the periods-by-score line, and FG/FGA/FT totals also cross-check. However, individual player names are largely illegible cursive handwriting (several surnames could not be read with confidence, and one row appears smudged/redacted), and several per-player cell digits (FGA, FTA, REB, PF, A, TO, BLK, S) required uncertain guesses to reconcile with team totals. Given the requirement to never invent values and to be ruthless about skipping rather than guessing, this game was skipped rather than publishing a transcription with unreliable names/cells despite the aggregate arithmetic appearing to close.
